title: Psalms 80
paragraphs: ¹ Listen, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock; you who dwell between the cherubim, shine forth. ² Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might and come to save us. ³ Restore us, O God; let your face shine on us, and we will be saved. ⁴ O LORD God of Hosts, how long will you smolder against the prayers of your people? ⁵ You have fed them with the bread of tears; you have made them drink tears by the bowlful.

⁶ You have made us an object of conflict among our neighbors, and our enemies mock us freely. ⁷ Restore us, God of Hosts; let your face shine on us, and we will be saved. ⁸ You transplanted a vine from Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it. ⁹ You cleared the ground for it, and it took deep root and filled the land. ¹⁰ The mountains were covered by its shade, the mighty cedars by its branches.

¹¹ Its branches stretched out to the sea and its shoots reached the river. ¹² Why have you broken down its walls so that all who pass by can pluck its fruit? ¹³ The wild boar from the forest ravages it, and the creatures of the field feed on it. ¹⁴ Return to us, God of Hosts! Look down from heaven and see; tend this vine, ¹⁵ the stock your right hand has planted, the branch you have raised up for yourself.

¹⁶ Your vine is cut down and burned with fire; at your rebuke your people perish. ¹⁷ Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you have raised up for yourself. ¹⁸ Then we will not turn away from you; revive us, and we will call on your name. ¹⁹ Restore us, LORD God of Hosts; let your face shine on us, and we will be saved.
